news.title: Purdue motorsports engineering student Dylan White races from pit lane to  Halloween Hundred victory
news.summary_en: Dylan White, a Purdue University student majoring inmotorsports engineering, turned an unexpected setback into a first-place finish, driving the No. 72 Dynoco Racing kart to victory in the Purdue Grand Prix Foundation’s third annual Halloween Hundred on Oct. 17 at the Purdue Grand Prix Track.

news.title: Seungjin Kim appointed Purdue's first chief nuclear officer
news.summary_en: Purdue announced Monday (Oct. 19) that nuclear energy expert Seungjin Kim has been appointed chief nuclear officer to lead the university's research and workforce development efforts in support of state and national needs.
